name: Sporthotel Manni
beschreibung:
Overview

MANNI das Hotel is a 4-star hotel right in the centre of Mayrhofen in the Zillertal in Tyrol. The address is Hauptstraße 439, 6290 Mayrhofen. The property is located in the pedestrian zone and thus, by its own account, “right in the middle of the action” – mountain railways, restaurants, bars, cafés and shops are all within immediate reach. According to bergfex, the establishment has around 47 rooms and about 100 beds. Amenities include Wi-Fi, a wellness area with sauna, a swimming pool, non-smoking rooms, balconies or terraces and parking; pets are allowed. Guests can choose from various rooms, studios and a MANNI Suite. The centrepiece is the MANNI ROOFTOP SPA.

History/Background

Today the hotel operates under the name MANNI das Hotel. In the tourism directory Tirol.de the establishment is listed as “4 Sterne Sporthotel Manni”, while the operator and booking portals use the spelling “MANNI das Hotel”. The operating company is Mannlicher Kur- und Sporthotel GmbH. The property presents itself as a sports-oriented, internationally minded hotel in the centre of Mayrhofen and has recently been repositioned under the MANNI brand. Reliable information on the founding year or individual renovation phases cannot be substantiated from the available sources and is therefore not stated.

Getting there

Mayrhofen is the central town in the rear Zillertal and is reachable all year round. The hotel is located directly at Hauptstraße 439 in the town centre and is excellently connected on foot, as shops, restaurants and the mountain railways are in the immediate vicinity. For arrival by car, parking spaces are available at the property, as listed in the establishment’s amenities list. The Zillertalbahn connects Mayrhofen station with the Jenbach railway junction on the Unterinntal line and is thus the public transport route into the region; from the town centre, buses and ski buses are an important part of mobility in the valley.

Tips

According to the operators, the hotel’s own à-la-carte restaurant combines Italian “dolce vita” with Tyrolean Alpine cuisine, complemented by a vital breakfast as a start to an active day. The MANNI ROOFTOP SPA with views of the Zillertal mountains, outdoor pool, whirlpool and sauna area is ideal for relaxing after hikes or days of skiing. The direct access to sporting facilities is convenient: the hotel includes shops and a ski rental, and according to the hotel the ski bus to Hintertux stops right in front of the building.

Best time to travel

Mayrhofen in the Zillertal is a year-round destination: in winter the region is connected to the large ski area around the Penken and the Mayrhofner Bergbahnen, while in summer hiking and mountain tours in the Zillertal Alps are on offer. A generally applicable, precisely dated seasonal recommendation cannot be substantiated from the available sources; the choice of travel date therefore depends on the desired winter or summer activity programme.
